entries.definition_zh: 若你必须始终在市场中,要么做多要么做空,这就是你当前的仓位(始终做多或始终做空)。若在任何时刻你被迫在建立多单与空单之间做选择并确信自己的选择,则市场在该时刻处于始终持仓(always-in)模式。几乎所有这些交易都需要趋势方向上的尖峰,交易者才会有信心。
entries.definition_en: If you have to be in the market at all times, either long or short, this is whatever your current position is (always in long or always in short). If at any time you are forced to decide between initiating a long or a short trade and are confident in your choice, then the market is in always-in mode at that moment. Almost all of these trades require a spike in the direction of the trend before traders will have confidence.
entries.note: 首次:始终持仓(always-in);模式名可保留 Always-In

entries.definition_zh: 三根或更多根大体重叠且一根或多根是十字星的震荡区间。它是一种带明显影线且常有相对较大K线的窄幅震荡区间。
entries.definition_en: A trading range of three or more bars that largely overlap and one or more is a doji. It is a type of tight trading range with prominent tails and often relatively large bars.
entries.note: Brooks 专用:多重重叠+十字星的窄幅震荡

entries.definition_zh: 在上攻中,单根回撤K线是低点低于前一根低点的K线。在下跌中,是高点高于前一根高点的K线。
entries.definition_en: In an upswing, a bar pullback is a bar with a low below the low of the prior bar. In a downswing, it is a bar with a high above that of the prior bar.

entries.definition_zh: 从上行到下行(空头趋势)的趋势变化。
entries.definition_en: A change in trend from up to down (a bear trend).

entries.definition_zh: 亏损使账户降至经纪商设定的最低保证金要求以下的账户,除非存入更多资金,否则不允许下单。
entries.definition_en: An account that your losses have reduced below the minimum margin requirements set by your broker, and you will not be allowed to place a trade unless you deposit more money.

entries.definition_zh: 当前K线的高点或低点延伸超过某个先前有意义的价格,如摆动高点或低点、任何前一根的高点或低点、趋势线或趋势通道。
entries.definition_en: The high or low of the current bar extends beyond some prior price of significance such as a swing high or low, the high or low of any prior bar, a trend line, or a trend channel.

entries.definition_zh: 创造突破的K线。通常是强趋势K线。
entries.definition_en: A bar that creates a breakout. It is usually a strong trend bar.

entries.definition_zh: 任一方向突破都应有跟随的形态。
entries.definition_en: A setup where a breakout in either direction should have followthrough.

entries.definition_zh: 突破后几根内发生的一到约五根的小回撤。由于你把它看作回撤,你预期突破会恢复,回撤是该恢复的形态。若你反而认为突破会失败,你不会用「回撤」一词,而会把回撤看作失败突破。例如,若有五根突破空头趋势线上方但你相信空头趋势会继续,你会考虑在这个空头旗形上做空,而不是在它向下突破后立即寻找买入回撤。
entries.definition_en: A small pullback of one to about five bars that occurs within a few bars after a breakout. Since you see it as a pullback, you are expecting the xiii xiv breakout to resume and the pullback is a setup for that resumption. If instead you thought that the breakout would fail, you would not use the term pullback and instead would see the pullback as a failed breakout. For example, if there was a five-bar breakout above a bear trend line but you believed that the bear trend would continue, you would be considering shorting this bear flag and not looking to buy a pullback immediately after it broke out to the downside.

entries.definition_zh: 接近原始入场价以测试保本止损的突破回撤。它可能超调或未达几个 tick。它可以发生在入场后一两根内,或在延伸行情之后,甚至 20 根或更多之后。
entries.definition_en: A breakout pullback that comes close to the original entry price to test a breakeven stop. It may overshoot it or undershoot it by a few ticks. It can occur within a bar or two of entry or after an extended move or even 20 or more bars later.

entries.definition_zh: 从下降趋势到上升趋势(多头趋势)的趋势变化。
entries.definition_en: A change in trend from a downtrend to an uptrend (a bull trend).

entries.definition_zh: 强多头在展现自己,他们的买入在创造多头趋势K线、底部有影线的K线,以及两K线多头反转。效应是累积的,通常最终后跟更高价格。
entries.definition_en: Strong bulls are asserting themselves and their buying is creating bull trend bars, bars with tails at the bottoms, and two-bar bull reversals. The effect is cumulative and usually is eventually followed by higher prices.

entries.definition_zh: 价格行为的图表表示,实体是开盘与收盘之间的区域。若收盘高于开盘,是多头蜡烛,显示为白色。若低于,是空头蜡烛,为黑色。上下的线称为影线(一些技术分析师称之为 wick 或 shadow)。
entries.definition_en: A chart representation of price action in which the body is the area between the open and the close. If the close is above the open, it is a bull candle and is shown as white. If it is below, it is a bear candle and is black. The lines above and below are called tails (some technicians call them wicks or shadows).
entries.note: 与 bar 在本书中常互换

entries.definition_zh: 线图、柱状图、蜡烛图、成交量图、tick 图或其他类型图表。
entries.definition_en: A line, bar, candle, volume, tick, or other type of chart.

entries.definition_zh: 走得太远太快、现已反转方向到震荡区间或相反趋势的行情。多数高潮以趋势通道超调与反转结束,但那些反转中多数导致震荡区间而非相反趋势。
entries.definition_en: A move that has gone too far too fast and has now reversed direction to either a trading range or an opposite trend. Most climaxes end with trend channel overshoots and reversals, but most of those reversals result in trading ranges and not an opposite trend.
entries.note: buy climax→买盘高潮;sell climax→卖盘高潮

entries.definition_zh: 与当前趋势(当前始终持仓方向)相反方向的交易或形态。对多数交易者这是亏损策略,因为风险通常至少与回报一样大,且概率很少高到足以使交易者公式有利。
entries.definition_en: A trade or setup that is in the opposite direction from the current

entries.definition_zh: 相信趋势还有更多空间但小回撤将至而做的交易;你逆势入场以在该小回撤形成时捕获小利润。这通常是错误,应避免。
entries.definition_en: A trade taken in the belief that there is more to go in the trend but that a small pullback is due; you enter countertrend to capture a small profit as that small pullback is forming. This is usually a mistake and should be avoided.

entries.definition_zh: 意图在入场当日离场的交易。
entries.definition_en: A trade where the intent is to exit on the day of entry.

entries.definition_zh: 市场在到达相反方向某个 tick 数之前先向上或向下移动任意 tick 数的概率。若你看等距上下运动,多数时候徘徊在 50% 附近,意味着市场在向下 X 个 tick 之前向上 X 个 tick 的机会是 50–50,在向上 X 个 tick 之前向下 X 个 tick 的机会也是 50–50。
entries.definition_en: The probability that the market will move either up or down any number of ticks before it reaches a certain number of ticks in the opposite direction. If you are looking at an equidistant move up and down, it hovers around 50 percent most of the time, which means that there is a 50–50 chance that the market will move up by X ticks before it moves down X ticks, and a 50–50 chance that it will move down X ticks before it moves up X ticks. xv

entries.definition_zh: 实体很小或完全没有实体的蜡烛。在 5 分钟图上,实体只会有一两个 tick;但在日线图上,实体可能有 10 个或更多 tick 仍几乎看起来不存在。多头与空头都未控制该K线。所有K线要么是趋势K线要么是非趋势K线,那些非趋势K线称为十字星。
entries.definition_en: A candle with a small body or no body at all. On a 5 minute chart, the body would be only one or two ticks; but on a daily chart, the body might be 10 or more ticks and still appear almost nonexistent. Neither the bulls nor the bears control the bar. All bars are either trend bars or nontrend bars, and those nontrend bars are called dojis.

entries.definition_zh: 当前K线低点与先前摆动低点大致相同的图表形态。该先前低点可以只早一根,或早 20 根或更多。它不必在当日低点,且常在多头旗形中形成(双底多头旗形)。
entries.definition_en: A chart formation in which the low of the current bar is about the same as the low of a prior swing low. That prior low can be just one bar earlier or 20 or more bars earlier. It does not have to be at the low of the day, and it commonly forms in bull flags (a double bottom bull flag).

entries.definition_zh: 多头趋势中有两次向下尖峰到大致相同价格然后反转回多头趋势的停顿或多头旗形。
entries.definition_en: A pause or bull flag in a bull trend that has two spikes down to around the same price and then reverses back into a bull trend.

entries.definition_zh: 由双底后跟形成更高低点的深回撤组成的买入形态。
entries.definition_en: A buy setup composed of a double bottom followed by a deep pullback that forms a higher low.

entries.definition_zh: 当前K线高点与先前摆动高点大致相同的图表形态。该先前高点可以只早一根,或早 20 根或更多。它不必在当日高点,且常在空头旗形中形成(双顶空头旗形)。
entries.definition_en: A chart formation in which the high of the current bar is about the same as the high of a prior swing high. That prior high can be just one bar earlier or 20 or more bars earlier. It does not have to be at the high of the day, and it commonly forms in bear flags (a double top bear flag).

entries.definition_zh: 空头趋势中有两次向上尖峰到大致相同价格然后反转回空头趋势的停顿或空头旗形。
entries.definition_en: A pause or bear flag in a bear trend that has two spikes up to around the same price and then reverses back into a bear trend.

entries.definition_zh: 由双顶后跟形成更低高点的深回撤组成的做空形态。
entries.definition_en: A sell setup composed of a double top followed by a deep pullback that forms a lower high.

entries.definition_zh: 在多头信号K线形成过程中就买入、而不是等它收盘然后在其高点上方 1 tick 用买入止损入场的交易者。
entries.definition_en: Traders who buy as a bull signal bar is forming rather than waiting for it to close and then entering on a buy stop at one tick above its high.

entries.definition_zh: 在空头信号K线形成过程中就卖出、而不是等它收盘然后在其低点下方 1 tick 用卖出止损入场的交易者。
entries.definition_en: Traders who sell as a bear signal bar is forming rather than waiting for it to close and then entering on a sell stop at one tick below its low.

entries.definition_zh: 具有正期望交易者公式的形态。若交易者交易该形态,他有数学优势。优势总是小且短暂的,因为它们需要对手方,而市场充满了不会允许优势又大又持久的聪明交易者。
entries.definition_en: A setup with a positive trader’s equation. The trader has a mathematical advantage if he trades the setup. Edges are always small and fleeting because they need someone on the other side, and the market is filled with smart traders who won’t allow an edge to be big and persistent.

entries.definition_zh: 见 exponential moving average(指数移动平均线)。
entries.definition_en: See exponential moving average (EMA).

entries.definition_zh: 交易入场所在的那根K线。
entries.definition_en: The bar during which a trade is entered.

entries.definition_zh: 本书图表使用 20 周期指数移动平均线,但任何移动平均线都可有用。
entries.definition_en: The charts in these books use a 20-bar exponential moving average, but any moving average can be useful.

entries.definition_zh: 在与趋势相反方向下单(例如,卖出你预期会失败并反转向下的多头突破)。
entries.definition_en: To place a trade in the opposite direction of the trend (for example, selling a bull breakout that you expect to fail and reverse downward).
entries.note: fade a breakout→逆势做失败突破

entries.definition_zh: 失败又失败,恢复到原始突破方向,因此是突破回撤。由于它是第二次信号,更 可靠。例如,若有震荡区间上方突破且突破后那根是空头反转K线,若市场交易到该K线下方,突破已失败。若市场然后在接下来几根内交易到前一根高点上方,失败突破已失败,现在突破在恢复。这意味着失败突破变成了小多头旗形,只是突破的回撤。
entries.definition_en: A failure that fails, resuming in the direction of the original breakout, and therefore a breakout pullback. Since it is a second signal, it is more xvi reliable. For example, if there is a breakout above a trading range and the bar after the breakout is a bear reversal bar, if the market trades below that bar, the breakout has failed. If the market then trades above the high of a prior bar within the next few bars, the failed breakout has failed and now the breakout is resuming. This means that the failed breakout became a small bull flag and just a pullback from the breakout.

entries.definition_zh: 保护性止损在剥头皮利润锁定或交易者目标到达之前被触发的行情,通常导致相反方向运动,因为被困交易者被迫带着亏损离场。目前,Emini 中四 tick 的剥头皮目标通常需要六 tick 的运动,QQQQ 中 10 tick 的目标通常需要 12 美分的运动。
entries.definition_en: A move where the protective stop is hit before a scalper’s profit is secured or before the trader’s objective is reached, usually leading to a move in the opposite direction as trapped traders are forced to exit at a loss. Currently, a scalper’s target in the Emini of four ticks usually requires a six-tick move, and a target in the QQQQ of 10 ticks usually requires a move of 12 cents.

entries.definition_zh: 失败的、失败。
entries.definition_en: Failed, failure.

entries.definition_zh: Emini 中到达信号K线之外五个 tick 然后反转的交易。例如,多头旗形突破运行五个 tick,一旦该K线收盘,下一根有更低的低点。多数锁定一点利润的限价单会无法成交,因为行情通常必须超过订单 1 tick 才会成交。它常是相反方向交易的形态。
entries.definition_en: A trade in the Emini that reaches five ticks beyond the signal bar and then reverses. For example, a breakout of a bull flag runs five ticks, and once the bar closes, the next bar has a low that is lower. Most limit orders to take a one-point profit would fail to get filled since a move usually has to go one tick beyond the order before it is filled. It is often a setup for a trade in the opposite direction.

entries.definition_zh: 指当前不持有任何仓位的交易者。
entries.definition_en: Refers to a trader who is not currently holding any positions.

entries.definition_zh: 在初始行情(如突破)之后,延伸该行情的一根或多根K线。交易者喜欢看到下一根及之后几根有跟随,希望有他们能赚更多的趋势。
entries.definition_en: After the initial move, like a breakout, it is one or more bars that extend the move. Traders like to see follow-through on the next bar and on the several bars after that, hoping for a trend where they stand to make more profit.

entries.definition_zh: 在入场K线之后创造跟随的K线;通常是下一根,但有时晚几根形成。
entries.definition_en: A bar that creates follow-through after the entry bar; it is usually the next bar but sometimes forms a couple of bars later.

entries.definition_zh: 每一个形态都是更高时间框架图上某个形态的分形。这意味着每一个形态在更高时间框架上是微型形态,每一个微型形态在更小时间框架上是标准形态。
entries.definition_en: Every pattern is a fractal of a pattern on a higher time frame chart. This means that every pattern is a micro pattern on a higher time frame and every micro pattern is a standard pattern on a smaller time frame.

entries.definition_zh: 图上任意两根价格K线之间的空间。跳空开盘是常见情况,若今日第一根的开盘超出前一根(昨日最后一根)或整日的高点或低点则存在。当K线低点在平坦或下降均线上方,或K线高点在平坦或上升均线下方时,存在均线缺口。日线图上的传统缺口(突破、度量与衰竭)在日内有各种趋势K线形式的等价物。
entries.definition_en: A space between any two price bars on the chart. An opening gap is a common occurrence and is present if the open of the first bar of today is beyond the high or low of the prior bar (the last bar of yesterday) or of the entire day. A moving average gap is present when the low of a bar is above a flat or falling moving average, or the high of a bar is below a flat or rising moving average. Traditional gaps (breakout, measuring, and exhaustion) on daily charts have intraday equivalents in the form of various trend bars.

entries.definition_zh: 见 moving average gap bar(均线缺口K线)。
entries.definition_en: See moving average gap bar.

entries.definition_zh: 当前K线向缺口方向延伸超出前一根 1 tick 的形态。例如,若跳空高开且当日第二根交易到第一根低点下方 1 tick,这是缺口反转。
entries.definition_en: A formation in which the current bar extends one tick beyond the prior bar back into the gap. For example, if there is a gap up open and the second bar of the day trades one tick below the low of the first bar, this is a gap reversal. xvii

entries.definition_zh: 见 high-frequency trading(高频交易)。
entries.definition_en: See high-frequency trading (HFT).

entries.definition_zh: 高于先前摆动高点的摆动高点。
entries.definition_en: A swing high that is higher than a previous swing high.

entries.definition_zh: 高于先前摆动低点的摆动低点。
entries.definition_en: A swing low that is higher than a previous swing low.

entries.definition_zh: 覆盖与当前图相同时间量但K线更少的图表。例如,与平均日的日盘 5 分钟 Emini 图相比,更高时间框架图的例子包括 15 分钟图、每根 25,000 tick 的 tick 图,以及每根 100,000 合约的成交量图(这些图在平均日通常少于 30 根,而 5 分钟图有 81 根)。
entries.definition_en: A chart covering the same amount of time as the current chart, but having fewer bars. For example, compared to the day session 5 minute Emini chart on an average day, examples of higher time frame charts include a 15 minute chart, a tick chart with 25,000 ticks per bar, and a volume chart with 100,000 contracts per bar (each of these charts usually has fewer than 30 bars on an average day, compared to the 81 bars on the 5 minute chart).

entries.definition_zh: 亦称算法交易或黑箱交易,是一种程序交易,公司每天在数千只股票上下数百万订单以剥头皮小至一美分的利润,交易基于统计分析而非基本面。
entries.definition_en: Also known as algorithmic trading or black box trading, it is a type of program trading where firms place millions of orders a day in thousands of stocks to scalp profits as small as a penny, and the trading is based on statistical analysis rather than fundamentals.

entries.definition_zh: High 1 或 2,或 Low 1 或 2。
entries.definition_en: Either a high 1 or 2 or a low 1 or 2.

entries.definition_zh: High 1 是多头旗形中或震荡区间底部附近高点高于前一根的K线。若然后有高点更低的K线(可在一根或几根后发生),该调整中下一根高点高于前一根高点的K线是 High 2。第三与第四次出现是 High 3 与 4。High 3 是楔形多头旗形变体。
entries.definition_en: A high 1 is a bar with a high above the prior bar in a bull flag or near the bottom of a trading range. If there is then a bar with a lower high (it can occur one or several bars later), the next bar in this correction whose high is above the prior bar’s high is a high 2. Third and fourth occurrences are a high 3 and 4. A high 3 is a wedge bull flag variant.
entries.note: Brooks 编号回撤买点;可保留英文编号

entries.definition_zh: 见 higher time frame(更高时间框架)。
entries.definition_en: See higher time frame (HTF).

entries.definition_zh: 连续内包K线,第二根在第一根内部。在一段结束时,它是突破模式形态,可成为旗形或反转形态。较不可靠的版本是「仅实体 ii」,忽略影线。这里,第二根实体在第一根实体内部,而第一根实体在其前一根实体内部。
entries.definition_en: Consecutive inside bars, where the second is inside the first. At the end of a leg, it is a breakout mode setup and can become a flag or a reversal setup. A less reliable version is a “bodies-only ii,” where you ignore the tails. Here, the second body is inside the first body, which is inside the body before it.

entries.definition_zh: 连续三根内包K线,比 ii 略更可靠的形态。
entries.definition_en: Three inside bars in a row, and a somewhat more reliable pattern than an ii.

entries.definition_zh: 高点在或低于前一根高点、低点在或高于前一根低点的K线。
entries.definition_en: A bar with a high that is at or below the high of the prior bar and a low that is at or above the low of the prior bar.

entries.definition_zh: 亦称聪明资金,可以是养老基金、对冲基金、保险公司、银行、经纪商、大型个人交易者,或任何交易量足以影响市场的实体。市场运动是许多机构下单的累积效应,单一机构单独通常无法长时间移动主要市场。传统机构基于基本面下单,他们曾是市场方向的唯一决定者。然而,HFT 公司现在对当日运动有显著影响,因为他们的交易目前产生当日多数成交量。HFT 公司是特殊类型的机构公司,他们的交易基于统计而非基本面。传统机构决定方向与目标,但数学家决定市场到达那里的路径。
entries.definition_en: Also called the smart money, it can be a pension fund, hedge fund, insurance company, bank, broker, large individual trader, or any other entity that trades enough volume to impact the market. Market movement is the cumulative effect of many institutions placing trades, and a single institution alone usually cannot move a major market for very long. Traditional institutions place trades based on fundamentals, and they used to be the sole determinant of the market’s direction. However, HFT firms now have a significant influence on the day’s movement since their trading currently generates most of the day’s volume. HFT firms are a special type of institutional firm and their trading is based on statistics and not fundamentals. Traditional institutions determine the direction and target, but mathematicians determine the path that the market takes to get there. xviii

entries.definition_zh: 内包-外包-内包——三根连续K线,第二根是外包K线,第三根是内包K线。它常是突破模式形态,交易者寻找在内包K线上方买入或下方卖出。
entries.definition_en: Inside-outside-inside—three consecutive bars where the second bar is an outside bar, and the third bar is an inside bar. It is often a breakout mode setup where a trader looks to buy above the inside bar or sell below it.

entries.definition_zh: 多头壁架是底部由两根或更多根相同低点的K线创造的小震荡区间;空头壁架是顶部由两根或更多根相同高点的K线创造的小震荡区间。
entries.definition_en: A bull ledge is a small trading range with a bottom created by two or more bars with identical lows; a bear ledge is a small trading range with a top created by two or more bars with identical highs.

entries.definition_zh: 突破任意大小趋势线的小趋势;该术语仅在图上至少有两段时使用。它是更大趋势一部分的任何更小趋势,可以是回撤(逆势运动)、趋势中或横盘市场中的摆动,或趋势中任意两次回撤之间发生的顺势运动。
entries.definition_en: A small trend that breaks a trend line of any size; the term is used only where there are at least two legs on the chart. It is any smaller trend that is part of a larger trend and it can be a pullback (a countertrend move), a swing in a trend or in a sideways market, or a with-trend move in a trend that occurs between any two pullbacks within the trend.

entries.definition_zh: 至少 60% 确定。
entries.definition_en: At least 60 percent certain.

entries.definition_zh: 在市场中买入仓位的人,或实际仓位本身。
entries.definition_en: A person who buys a position in a market or the actual position itself.

entries.definition_zh: 市场中可交易的最小仓位规模。指股票时是一股,指 Emini 或其他期货时是一张合约。
entries.definition_en: The smallest position size that can be traded in a market. It is a share when referring to stocks and a contract when referring to Eminis or other futures.

entries.definition_zh: 低于先前摆动高点的摆动高点。
entries.definition_en: A swing high that is lower than a previous swing high.

entries.definition_zh: 低于先前摆动低点的摆动低点。
entries.definition_en: A swing low that is lower than a previous swing low.

entries.definition_zh: Low 1 是空头旗形中或震荡区间顶部附近低点低于前一根的K线。若然后有低点更高的K线(可在一根或几根后发生),该调整中下一根低点低于前一根低点的K线是 Low 2。第三与第四次出现是 Low 3 与 4。Low 3 是楔形空头旗形变体。
entries.definition_en: A low 1 is a bar with a low below the prior bar in a bear flag or near the top of a trading range. If there is then a bar with a higher low (it can occur one or several bars later), the next bar in this correction whose low is below the prior bar’s low is a low 2. Third and fourth occurrences are a low 3 and 4. A low 3 is a wedge bear flag variant.

entries.definition_zh: 包含屏幕上多数价格行为的任何趋势线,通常用至少相隔 10 根的K线绘制。
entries.definition_en: Any trend line that contains most of the price action on the screen and is typically drawn using bars that are at least 10 bars apart.

entries.definition_zh: 从多头到空头趋势或从空头到多头趋势的反转。形态必须包括趋势线突破后对旧趋势极端的测试。
entries.definition_en: A reversal from a bull to a bear trend or from a bear trend to a bull trend. The setup must include a test of the old trend extreme after a break of the trend line.

entries.definition_zh: 空头尖峰或窄空头通道中没有显著回撤、且延伸超过基本面所指示的抛售。
entries.definition_en: A sell-off in a bear spike or a tight bear channel without significant pullbacks and that extends further than the fundamentals would dictate.

entries.definition_zh: 多头尖峰或窄多头通道中没有显著回撤、且延伸超过基本面所指示的反弹。
entries.definition_en: A rally in a bull spike or a tight bull channel without significant pullbacks and that extends further than the fundamentals would dictate.

entries.definition_zh: 任何传统形态可在一到约五根上形成且仍有效,尽管容易被忽略。当它形成时,是该形态的微型版本。每一个微型形态在更小时间框架图上是传统形态,每一个传统形态在更高时间框架图上是微型形态。
entries.definition_en: Any traditional pattern can form over one to about five bars and still be valid, although easily overlooked. When it forms, it is a micro version of the pattern. Every micro pattern is a traditional pattern on a smaller time frame chart, and every traditional pattern is a micro pattern on a higher time frame chart.

entries.definition_zh: 非常窄的通道,多数K线的高点与低点触及趋势线,且常也触及趋势通道线。它是 窄通道最极端的形式,没有回撤或只有一两次小回撤。
entries.definition_en: A very tight channel where most of the bars have their highs and lows touching the trend line and, often, also the trend channel line. It is the most xix extreme form of a tight channel, and it has no pullbacks or only one or two small pullbacks.

entries.definition_zh: 连续或近乎连续、低点接近相同价格的K线。
entries.definition_en: Consecutive or nearly consecutive bars with lows that are near the same price.

entries.definition_zh: 连续或近乎连续、高点接近相同价格的K线。
entries.definition_en: Consecutive or nearly consecutive bars with highs that are near the same price.

entries.definition_zh: 当强趋势K线前一根与后一根不重叠时,这是强度信号,常导致等幅运动。例如,若有强多头趋势K线且其后一根的低点在其前一根高点处或上方,该低点与该高点的中点是微型度量缺口。
entries.definition_en: When the bar before and the bar after a strong trend bar do not overlap, this is a sign of strength and often leads to a measured move. For example, if there is a strong bull trend bar and the low of the bar after it is at or above the high of the bar before it, the midpoint between that low and that high is the micro measuring gap.

entries.definition_zh: 跨三到五根连续K线高点或低点画出的趋势通道线。
entries.definition_en: A trend channel line drawn across the highs or lows of three to five consecutive bars.

entries.definition_zh: 任意时间框架上跨两到约 10 根画出的趋势线,多数K线触及或接近趋势线,然后其中一根有穿过趋势线的假突破。该假突破设置顺势入场。若它在一两根内失败,则通常有逆势交易。
entries.definition_en: A trend line on any time frame that is drawn across from two to about 10 bars where most of the bars touch or are close to the trend line, and then one of the bars has a false breakout through the trend line. This false breakout sets up a with-trend entry. If it fails within a bar or two, then there is usually a countertrend trade.

entries.definition_zh: 基于固定美元金额或点数的止损,如 Emini 中的两点或股票中的一美元。
entries.definition_en: A stop based on a fixed dollar amount or number of points, like two points in the Eminis or a dollar in a stock.

entries.definition_zh: 本书图表使用 20 周期指数移动平均线,但任何移动平均线都可有用。
entries.definition_en: The charts in this book use a 20-bar exponential moving average, but any moving average can be useful.

entries.definition_zh: 未触及均线的K线。K线与均线之间的空间是缺口。强趋势中导致均线缺口K线的第一次回撤通常后跟对趋势极端的测试。例如,当有强多头趋势且有回撤最终出现高点在均线下方的K线时,这常是测试趋势高点的买入形态。
entries.definition_en: A bar that does not touch the moving average. The space between the bar and the moving average is the gap. The first pullback in a strong trend that results in a moving average gap bar is usually followed by a test of the trend’s extreme. For example, when there is a strong bull trend and there is a pullback that finally has a bar with a high below the moving average, this is often a buy setup for a test of the high of the trend.

entries.definition_zh: 有时形态内部有可比形态的更小版本「嵌套」。例如,头肩顶的右肩常是小头肩顶或双顶。
entries.definition_en: Sometimes a pattern has a smaller version of a comparable pattern “nested” within it. For example, it is common for the right shoulder of a head and shoulders top to be either a small head and shoulders top or a double top.

entries.definition_zh: 媒体仅为销售广告并为媒体公司赚钱而产生的无用信息。它与交易无关,无法评估,应始终忽略。
entries.definition_en: Useless information generated by the media for the sole purpose of selling advertising and making money for the media company. It is unrelated to trading, is impossible to evaluate, and should always be ignored.

entries.definition_zh: 外包-内包-外包,外包K线后跟内包K线,再后跟外包K线。
entries.definition_en: Outside-inside-outside, an outside bar followed by an inside bar, followed by an outside bar.

entries.definition_zh: 外包-外包,外包K线后跟更大的外包K线。
entries.definition_en: Outside-outside, an outside bar followed by a larger outside bar.

entries.definition_zh: 当日第一小时左右的反转。
entries.definition_en: A reversal in the first hour or so of the day. xx

entries.definition_zh: 高点高于或等于前一根高点且低点低于前一根低点的K线,或低点低于或等于前一根低点且高点高于前一根高点的K线。
entries.definition_en: A bar with a high that is above or at the high of the prior bar and a low that is below the low of the prior bar, or a bar with a low that is below or at the low of the prior bar and a high that is above the high of the prior bar.

entries.definition_zh: 收盘低于开盘的外包K线。
entries.definition_en: An outside bar with a close below its open.

entries.definition_zh: 收盘高于开盘的外包K线。
entries.definition_en: An outside bar with a close above its open.

entries.definition_zh: 市场超过先前有意义的价格,如摆动点或趋势线。
entries.definition_en: The market surpasses a prior price of significance like a swing point or a trend line.

entries.definition_zh: 不延伸趋势的K线。在多头趋势中,停顿K线高点在或低于前一根,或当前一根是强多头趋势K线时有高点仅比前一根高一两个 tick 的小K线。它是一种回撤。
entries.definition_en: A bar that does not extend the trend. In a bull trend, a pause bar has a high that is at or below the prior bar, or a small bar with a high that is only a tick or so higher than the previous bar when the previous bar is a strong bull trend bar. It is a type of pullback.

entries.definition_zh: 外汇(forex)市场中的 tick。然而,一些数据供应商提供带额外小数位的报价,应忽略。
entries.definition_en: A tick in the foreign exchange (forex) market. However, some data vendors provide quotes with an extra decimal place, which should be ignored.

entries.definition_zh: 在多头趋势中,多头在多头尖峰中以及市场突破至新高时加多,因为他们预期大约等幅运动的另一段上行。
entries.definition_en: In a bull trend, bulls add to their longs as in a bull spike and as the market breaks out to a new high, because they expect another leg up to about a measured move.

entries.definition_zh: 在空头趋势中,空头在空头尖峰中以及市场突破至新低时加空,因为他们预期大约等幅运动的另一段下行。
entries.definition_en: In a bear trend, bears add to their shorts in a bear spike and as the market breaks out to a new low, because they expect another leg down to about a measured move.

entries.definition_zh: 任何图表类型或时间框架上价格的任何变化。
entries.definition_en: Any change in price on any chart type or time frame.

entries.definition_zh: 成功的机会。例如,若交易者回顾最近 100 次某形态导致交易的情况并发现 60 次导致盈利交易,则表明该形态有约 60% 的成功概率。有许多永远无法充分测试的变量,因此概率只是近似,有时可能非常误导。
entries.definition_en: The chance of success. For example, if a trader looks back at the most recent 100 times a certain setup led to a trade and finds that it led to a profitable trade 60 times, then that would indicate that the setup has about a 60 percent probability of success. There are many variables that can never be fully tested, so probabilities are only approximations and at times can be very misleading.

entries.definition_zh: 至少 60% 确定。
entries.definition_en: At least 60 percent certain.

entries.definition_zh: 作为趋势、摆动或一段一部分的暂时停顿或逆势运动,且不回撤超过趋势、摆动或一段的起点。它是交易者预期趋势很快恢复的小震荡区间。例如,空头回撤是空头趋势、摆动或一段中的横盘到上行运动,随后会至少测试先前低点。它可以小至前一根高点上方 1 tick 的运动,甚至可以是停顿,如内包K线。
entries.definition_en: A temporary pause or countertrend move that is part of a trend, swing, or leg and does not retrace beyond the start of the trend, swing, or leg. It is a small trading range where traders expect the trend to resume soon. For example, a bear pullback is a sideways to upward move in a bear trend, swing, or leg that will be followed by at least a test of the prior low. It can be as small as a one-tick move above the high of the prior bar or it can even be a pause, like an inside bar.

entries.definition_zh: 至少 1 tick 反转前一根的K线。在上升趋势中,是低点低于前一根低点的K线。
entries.definition_en: A bar that reverses the prior bar by at least one tick. In an uptrend, it is a bar with a low below that of the prior bar.

entries.definition_zh: 具有有利交易者公式的形态。
entries.definition_en: A setup with a favorable trader’s equation.

entries.definition_zh: 变为相反类型行为的变化。多数技术分析师用该词指从多头趋势到空头趋势或从空头到 多头趋势的变化。然而,震荡区间行为与趋势行为相反,因此当趋势变成震荡区间时,这也是反转。当震荡区间变成趋势时,它是反转但通常称为突破。
entries.definition_en: A change to an opposite type of behavior. Most technicians use the term to mean a change from a bull trend to a bear trend or from a bear trend to a bull xxi trend. However, trading range behavior is opposite to trending behavior, so when a trend becomes a trading range, this is also a reversal. When a trading range becomes a trend, it is a reversal but is usually called a breakout.

entries.definition_zh: 与趋势相反方向的趋势K线。当空头腿在向上反转时,多头反转K线是多头趋势K线,经典描述包括底部影线以及收盘高于开盘并靠近顶部。空头反转K线是多头腿中的空头趋势K线,传统描述包括顶部影线以及收盘低于开盘并靠近底部。
entries.definition_en: A trend bar in the opposite direction of the trend. When a bear leg is reversing up, a bull reversal bar is a bull trend bar, and the classic description includes a tail at the bottom and a close above the open and near the top. A bear reversal bar is a bear trend bar in a bull leg, and the traditional description includes a tail at the top and a close below the open and near the bottom.

entries.definition_zh: 交易者预期从交易中赚取的 tick 数。例如,若交易者以限价单在止盈目标离场,它是入场价与止盈目标之间的 tick 数。
entries.definition_en: The number of ticks that a trader expects to make from a trade. For example, if the trader exits with a limit order at a profit target, it is the number of ticks between the entry price and the profit target.

entries.definition_zh: 从交易者入场价到保护性止损的 tick 数。若交易对其不利,这是交易者会亏损的最小值(滑点和其他因素可使实际风险大于理论风险)。
entries.definition_en: The number of ticks from a trader’s entry price to a protective stop. It is the minimum that the trader will lose if a trade goes against him (slippage and other factors can make the actual risk greater than the theoretical risk).

entries.definition_zh: 当交易者认为股市会下跌时,他们变得厌恶风险,卖出波动性股票与货币,并转向避险投资,如强生(JNJ)、奥驰亚集团(MO)、宝洁(PG)、美元与瑞士法郎。
entries.definition_en: When traders think that the stock market will fall, they become risk averse, sell out of volatile stocks and currencies, and transition into safe-haven investments, like Johnson & Johnson (JNJ), Altria Group (MO), Procter & Gamble (PG), the U.S. dollar, and the Swiss franc.

entries.definition_zh: 当交易者认为股市强劲时,他们愿意承担更多风险并投资倾向于比整体市场涨得更快的股票,以及投资波动性更大的货币,如澳元或瑞典克朗。
entries.definition_en: When traders think that the stock market is strong, they are willing to take more risks and invest in stocks that tend to rise faster than the overall market, and invest in more volatile currencies, like the Australian dollar or the Swedish krona.

entries.definition_zh: 当交易者公式不清晰或对交易仅勉强有利时。也可意味着无论风险与潜在回报如何,交易的成功概率是 50% 或更低。
entries.definition_en: When the trader’s equation is unclear or barely favorable for a trade. It can also mean that the probability of success for a trade is 50 percent or less, regardless of the risk and potential reward.

entries.definition_zh: 以小利润离场的交易,通常在有任何回撤之前。在 Emini 中,当平均波幅约 10 到 15 点时,剥头皮交易通常是目标少于四点的任何交易。对 SPY 或股票,可能是 10 到 30 美分。对更贵的股票,可以是 1 到 2 美元。由于利润常小于风险,交易者必须至少 70% 的时间获胜,这对多数交易者是不现实的目标。交易者应只做潜在回报至少与风险一样大的交易,除非他们极其熟练。
entries.definition_en: A trade that is exited with a small profit, usually before there are any pullbacks. In the Emini, when the average range is about 10 to 15 points, a scalp trade is usually any trade where the goal is less than four points. For the SPY or stocks, it might be 10 to 30 cents. For more expensive stocks, it can be $1 to $2. Since the profit is often smaller than the risk, a trader has to win at least 70 percent of the time, which is an unrealistic goal for most traders. Traders should take trades only where the potential reward is at least as great as the risk unless they are extremely skilled.

entries.definition_zh: 主要剥头皮小利润、通常使用紧密止损的交易者。
entries.definition_en: A trader who primarily scalps for small profits, usually using a tight stop.

entries.definition_zh: 剥头皮交易者通常会瞄准的典型利润金额。
entries.definition_en: A typical amount of profit that a scalper would be targeting.

entries.definition_zh: 接近保本、有小利润或小亏损的交易。
entries.definition_en: A trade that is close to breakeven with either a small profit or a loss.

entries.definition_zh: 在第一次入场后几根内,基于与第一次入场相同逻辑出现入场K线的第二次。例如,若 楔形多头旗形上方突破失败并回撤到双底多头旗形,该回撤设置了楔形多头旗形的第二次买入信号。
entries.definition_en: The second time within a few bars of the first entry where there is an entry bar based on the same logic as the first entry. For example, if a xxii breakout above a wedge bull flag fails and pulls back to a double bottom bull flag, this pullback sets up a second buy signal for the wedge bull flag.

entries.term_en: second moving average gap bar setup
entries.term_zh: 第二次均线缺口K线形态
aliases_en: second moving average gap bar setup
aliases_zh: 第二次均线缺口K线形态
entries.definition_zh: 若有第一次均线缺口K线,且向均线的反转未到达均线,反而远离均线的运动继续,它是朝均线方向的下一次反转。
entries.definition_en: If there is a first moving average gap bar and a reversal toward the moving average does not reach the moving average, and instead the move away from the moving average continues, it is the next reversal in the direction of the moving average.

entries.definition_zh: 在第一次信号后几根内,基于与第一次信号相同逻辑的形态的第二次。
entries.definition_en: The second time within a few bars of the first signal where there is a setup based on the same logic as the first signal.

entries.definition_zh: 强空头在展现自己,他们的卖出在创造空头趋势K线、顶部有影线的K线,以及两K线空头反转。效应是累积的,通常最终后跟更低价格。
entries.definition_en: Strong bears are asserting themselves and their selling is creating bear trend bars, bars with tails at the tops, and two-bar bear reversals. The effect is cumulative and usually is eventually followed by lower prices.

entries.definition_zh: 交易者用作下入场单依据的一根或多根K线形态。若入场单成交,形态的最后一根成为信号K线。多数形态只是单根K线。
entries.definition_en: A pattern of one or more bars used by traders as the basis to place entry orders. If an entry order is filled, the last bar of the setup becomes the signal bar. Most setups are just a single bar.
entries.note: 语境偏「形态」时用交易形态

entries.definition_zh: 一端或两端没有影线的蜡烛。光头顶部没有上影线,光脚底部没有下影线。
entries.definition_en: A candle with no tail at one or both ends. A shaved top has no tail at the top and a shaved bottom has no tail at the bottom.

entries.definition_zh: 作为动词,卖出股票或期货合约以建立新仓位(不是离场先前买入)。作为名词,做空某物的人,或实际仓位本身。
entries.definition_en: As a verb, to sell a stock or futures contract to initiate a new position (not to exit a prior purchase). As a noun, a person who sells something short, or the actual position itself.

entries.definition_zh: 最近突破小于前一次的阶梯形态。它是多头趋势中三个或更多趋势性高点或空头趋势中低点的系列,每一次突破至新极端的 tick 数少于前一次突破,表明动能衰减。它可以是三推形态,但不必像楔形,可以是趋势中任何系列的宽摆动。
entries.definition_en: A stairs pattern where the most recent breakout is smaller than the previous one. It is a series of three or more trending highs in a bull trend or lows in a bear trend where each breakout to a new extreme is by fewer ticks than the prior breakout, indicating waning momentum. It can be a three-push pattern, but it does not have to resemble a wedge and can be any series of broad swings in a trend.

entries.definition_zh: 入场单成交所在K线(入场K线)紧前的那根。它是形态的最后一根。
entries.definition_en: The bar immediately before the bar in which an entry order is filled (the entry bar). It is the final bar of a setup.

entries.definition_zh: 覆盖与当前图相同时间量但K线更多的图表。例如,与平均日的日盘 5 分钟 Emini 图相比,更低时间框架图的例子包括 1 分钟图、每根 500 tick 的 tick 图,以及每根 1,000 合约的成交量图(这些图在平均日通常超过 200 根,而 5 分钟图有 81 根)。
entries.definition_en: A chart covering the same amount of time as the current chart, but having more bars. For example, compared to the day session 5 minute Emini chart on an average day, examples of smaller time frame charts include a 1 minute chart, a tick chart with 500 ticks per bar, and a volume chart with 1,000 contracts per bar (each of these charts usually has more than 200 bars on an average day, compared to the 81 bars on the 5 minute chart).

entries.definition_zh: 持续盈利、通常交易大仓位且一般站在市场正确一侧的交易者。
entries.definition_en: Consistently profitable traders who are usually trading large positions and are generally on the right side of the market.

entries.definition_zh: 突破进入趋势,跟随以通道形式出现,动能更小且有双边交易在进行。
entries.definition_en: A breakout into a trend in which the follow-through is in the form of a channel where the momentum is less and there is two-sided trading taking place. xxiii

entries.definition_zh: 趋势型震荡趋势或宽通道趋势中推至新极端的一次推进,有一系列三个或更多趋势性摆动,类似倾斜的震荡区间并大致包含在通道中。突破后,有至少略微回撤进入先前震荡区间的突破回撤,这不是其他趋势型震荡的要求。双边交易在进行,但一方略微更控制,造成斜率。
entries.definition_en: A push to a new extreme in a trending trading range trend or a broad channel trend where there is a series of three or more trending swings that resembles a sloping trading range and is roughly contained in a channel. After the breakout, there is a breakout pullback that retraces at least slightly into the prior trading range, which is not a requirement of other trending trading ranges. Twoway trading is taking place but one side is in slightly more control, accounting for the slope.
entries.note: broad channel stairs→宽通道阶梯趋势

entries.definition_zh: 见 smaller time frame(更低时间框架)。
entries.definition_en: See smaller time frame (STF).

entries.definition_zh: 机构交易者及其累积买卖决定市场方向。
entries.definition_en: Institutional traders and their cumulative buying and selling determine the direction of the market.

entries.definition_zh: 指交易者实现其目标。他们的止盈目标在保护性止损被触发之前到达。
entries.definition_en: Refers to traders achieving their objective. Their profit target was reached before their protective stop was hit.

entries.definition_zh: 突破任意大小趋势线的更小趋势;该术语仅在图上至少有两个时使用。它们可发生在更大趋势中或横盘市场中。
entries.definition_en: A smaller trend that breaks a trend line of any size; the term is used only when there are at least two on the chart. They can occur within a larger trend or in a sideways market.

entries.definition_zh: 在图上看起来像向上尖峰并向上延伸超出邻近K线的K线。其高点在或高于其前一根及其后一根。
entries.definition_en: A bar that looks like a spike up on the chart and extends up beyond the neighboring bars. Its high is at or above that of the bar before it and that of the bar after it.

entries.definition_zh: 摆动高点或摆动低点。
entries.definition_en: Either a swing high or a swing low.

entries.definition_zh: 在图上看起来像向下尖峰并向下延伸超出邻近K线的K线。其低点在或低于其前一根及其后一根。
entries.definition_en: A bar that looks like a spike down on the chart and extends down beyond the neighboring bars. Its low is at or below that of the bar before it and that of the bar after it.

entries.definition_zh: 摆动高点或摆动低点。
entries.definition_en: Either a swing high or a swing low.

entries.definition_zh: 对使用如 5 分钟这样短期日内图的日内交易者,是任何持续长于剥头皮、且交易者会扛过一次或多次回撤的交易。对使用更高时间框架图的交易者,是持续数小时到数日的交易。通常,至少部分交易没有止盈目标持有,因为交易者希望有延伸行情。潜在回报通常至少与风险一样大。小的波段交易被许多交易者称为剥头皮。在 Emini 中,当平均波幅约 10 到 15 点时,波段交易通常是目标四点或更多的任何交易。
entries.definition_en: For a day trader using a short-term intraday chart like the 5 minute, it is any trade that lasts longer than a scalp and that the trader will hold through one or more pullbacks. For a trader using higher time frame charts, it is a trade that lasts for hours to several days. Typically, at least part of the trade is held without a profit target, since the trader is hoping for an extended move. The potential reward is usually at least as large as the risk. Small swing trades are called scalps by many traders. In the Emini, when the average range is about 10 to 15 points, a swing trade is usually any trade where the goal is four or more points.

entries.definition_zh: 当市场接近先前有意义的价格,可以超调或未达目标。「失败测试」一词被不同交易者用来指相反的事物。多数交易者相信若市场然后反转,测试是成功的;若没有且行情继续超过测试区域,测试失败且突破已发生。
entries.definition_en: When the market approaches a prior price of significance and can overshoot or undershoot the target. The term failed test is used to mean opposite things by different traders. Most traders believe that if the market then reverses, the test was successful, and if it does not and the move continues beyond the test area, the test failed and a breakout has occurred.

entries.definition_zh: 三个摆动高点(每个通常更高)或三个摆动低点(每个通常更低)。它与楔形交易方式相同 并应被视为变体。当它是旗形一部分时,运动可以大体水平,每次推进不必延伸超过前一次。例如,在楔形多头旗形或任何其他类型三角形中,第二次下推可以在第一次处、上方或下方,第三次下推可以在第二次或第一次或二者处、上方或下方。
entries.definition_en: Three swing highs where each swing high is usually higher or three swing lows where each swing low is usually lower. It trades the same as a wedge xxiv and should be considered a variant. When it is part of a flag, the move can be mostly horizontal and each push does not have to extend beyond the prior one. For example, in a wedge bull flag or any other type of triangle, the second push down can be at, above, or below the first, and the third push down can be at, above, or below either the second or the first, or both.

entries.definition_zh: 价格运动的最小单位。对多数股票是一美分;对 10 年期美国国债期货是 1/64 点;对 Emini 是 0.25 点。在 tick 图与分时成交表上,一次 tick 是发生的每一笔交易,无论规模,即便没有价格变化。若你看分时成交表,当 TradeStation 绘图软件创建 tick 图时,每一笔交易计为一次 tick。
entries.definition_en: The smallest unit of price movement. For most stocks, it is one penny; for 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Futures, it is 1/64th of a point; and for Eminis, it is 0.25 points. On tick charts and on time and sales tables, a tick is every trade that takes place no matter the size and even if there is no price change. If you look at a time and sales table, every trade is counted as one tick when TradeStation charting software creates a tick chart.
entries.note: 保留 tick 时可写「tick(最小变动单位)」

entries.definition_zh: 趋势线与趋势通道线靠得很近、回撤很小且只持续一到三根的通道。
entries.definition_en: A channel where the trend line and trend channel line are close together, and the pullbacks are small and last for only one to three bars.

entries.definition_zh: 两根或更多根有大量重叠的震荡区间,其中多数反转太小而无法用止损入场盈利交易。多头与空头处于均衡。
entries.definition_en: A trading range of two or more bars with lots of overlap in the bars and in which most reversals are too small to trade profitably with stop entries. The bulls and bears are in balance.

entries.definition_zh: 图上一根K线包含的时间长度(5 分钟时间框架由每五分钟收盘的K线组成)。也可指不基于时间的K线,如基于成交量或成交 tick 数的K线。
entries.definition_en: The length of time contained in one bar on the chart (a 5 minute time frame is made of bars that close every five minutes). It can also refer to bars not based on time, such as those based on volume or the number of ticks traded.

entries.definition_zh: 你相信有合理机会导致至少剥头皮利润的形态。
entries.definition_en: A setup that you believe has a reasonable chance of leading to at least a scalper’s profit.

entries.definition_zh: 要做一笔交易,你必须相信成功概率乘以潜在回报大于失败概率乘以风险。你设定回报与风险,因为潜在回报是到止盈目标的距离,风险是到止损的距离。解方程的困难在于给概率赋值,而这永远无法确定地知道。作为指引,若你不确定,假设你有 50% 的机会赢或输;若你有信心,假设你有 60% 的机会赢、40% 的机会输。
entries.definition_en: To take a trade, you must believe that the probability of success times the potential reward is greater than the probability of failure times the risk. You set the reward and risk because the potential reward is the distance to your profit target and the risk is the distance to your stop. The difficulty in solving the equation is assigning a value to the probability, which can never be known with certainty. As a guideline, if you are uncertain, assume that you have a 50 percent chance of winning or losing, and if you are confident, assume that you have a 60 percent chance of winning and a 40 percent chance of losing.

entries.definition_zh: 最低要求是单根与其前一根大体重叠的K线。它是横盘运动,多头与空头都未控制,尽管一方常更强。它常是趋势中的回撤,该回撤已持续足够久以失去多数确定性。换言之,交易者对短期突破方向变得不确定,市场会有反复的上下突破尝试会失败。它最终通常会向趋势方向突破,并在更高时间框架图上是回撤。
entries.definition_en: The minimum requirement is a single bar with a range that is largely overlapped by the bar before it. It is sideways movement and neither the bull nor the bears are in control, although one side is often stronger. It is often a pullback in a trend where the pullback has lasted long enough to lose most of its certainty. In other words, traders have become uncertain about the direction of the breakout in the short term, and the market will have repeated breakout attempts up and down that will fail. It will usually ultimately break out in the direction of the trend, and is a pullback on a higher time frame chart. xxv

entries.definition_zh: 随着交易越来越盈利,交易者常会移动或跟踪保护性止损以保护更多浮动利润。例如,若他们在多头趋势中做多,每当市场移至新高,他们可能把保护性止损抬到最近更高低点略下方。
entries.definition_en: As the trade becomes increasingly profitable, traders will often move, or trail, the protective stop to protect more of their open profit. For example, if they are long in a bull trend, every time the market moves to a new high, they might raise the protective stop to just below the most recent higher low.

entries.definition_zh: 立即反转到相反方向、在剥头皮利润目标到达之前的入场,把交易者困在其新仓位中并最终迫使他们带着亏损离场。它也可把交易者吓出好交易。
entries.definition_en: An entry that immediately reverses to the opposite direction before a scalper’s profit target is reached, trapping traders in their new position and ultimately forcing them to cover at a loss. It can also scare traders out of a good trade.

entries.definition_zh: 交易者在未导致剥头皮利润的交易上有浮动亏损,若有回撤超出入场或信号K线,交易者很可能带着亏损离场。
entries.definition_en: A trader with an open loss on a trade that did not result in a scalper’s profit, and if there is a pullback beyond the entry or signal bars, the trader will likely exit with a loss.

entries.definition_zh: 把交易者吓出交易的回撤,但然后回撤失败。行情迅速向交易方向恢复,使交易者在情感上难以以现在可得的更差价格重新入场。交易者将不得不追赶市场。
entries.definition_en: A pullback that scares a trader into exiting a trade, but then the pullback fails. The move quickly resumes in the direction of the trade, making it difficult emotionally for the trader to get back in at the worse price that is now available. The trader will have to chase the market.

entries.definition_zh: 大体上行(多头趋势)或下行(空头趋势)的系列价格变化。有三个定义宽松的更小版本:摆动、一段与回撤。一张图只会显示一两个主要趋势。若有更多,其他术语之一更合适。
entries.definition_en: A series of price changes that are either mostly up (a bull trend) or down (a bear trend). There are three loosely defined smaller versions: swings, legs, and pullbacks. A chart will show only one or two major trends. If there are more, one of the other terms is more appropriate.

entries.definition_zh: 有实体的K线,意味着收盘高于或低于开盘,表明至少有小的价格运动。
entries.definition_en: A bar with a body, which means that the close was above or below the open, indicating that there is at least a minor price movement.

entries.definition_zh: 沿趋势方向但画在与趋势线相对一侧K线上的线。多头趋势通道线在高点上方并向右上升,空头趋势通道线在低点下方并向右下降。
entries.definition_en: A line in the direction of the trend but drawn on the opposite side of the bars compared to a trend line. A bull trend channel line is above the highs and rising to the right, and a bear trend channel line is below the lows and falling to the right.

entries.definition_zh: 一根或多根K线穿透趋势通道线。
entries.definition_en: One or more bars penetrating a trend channel line.

entries.definition_zh: K线接近趋势通道线但市场在到达或穿透该线之前远离该线反转。
entries.definition_en: A bar approaches a trend channel line but the market reverses away from the line without reaching or penetrating it.

entries.definition_zh: 从当日第一根或最初几根之一开始、延伸许多根没有回撤的趋势,且趋势起点在当日大部分或全部时间保持为当日极端之一。
entries.definition_en: A trend that begins at the first or one of the first bars of the day and extends for many bars without a pullback, and the start of the trend remains as one of the extremes of the day for much if not all of the day.

entries.definition_zh: 三根或更多收盘在趋势中的K线。在多头趋势中,每个收盘高于前一个收盘;在空头趋势中,每个收盘更低。若形态延伸许多根,可以有一两根收盘不在趋势中。
entries.definition_en: Three or more bars where the closes are trending. In a bull trend, each close is above the prior close, and in a bear trend, each close is lower. If the pattern extends for many bars, there can be one or two bars where the closes are not trending.

entries.definition_zh: 与趋势性收盘相同,但基于K线的高点或低点。
entries.definition_en: The same as trending closes except based on the highs or lows of the bars. xxvi

entries.definition_zh: 三个或更多摆动,摆动高低点都高于先前摆动高低点(趋势性多头摆动),或都更低(趋势性空头摆动)。
entries.definition_en: Three or more swings where the swing highs and lows are both higher than the prior swing highs and lows (trending bull swings), or both lower (trending bear swings).

entries.definition_zh: 由突破隔开的两个或更多震荡区间。
entries.definition_en: Two or more trading ranges separated by a breakout.

entries.definition_zh: 沿趋势方向画出的线;在多头趋势中向上倾斜并在K线下方,在空头趋势中向下倾斜并在K线上方。最常由摆动高点或摆动低点构建,但可基于线性回归或仅最佳拟合(目测)。
entries.definition_en: A line drawn in the direction of the trend; it is sloped up and is below the bars in a bull trend, and it is sloped down and is above the bars in a bear trend. Most often, it is constructed from either swing highs or swing lows but can be based on linear regression or just a best fit (eyeballing).

entries.definition_zh: 从上行到下行或从下行到上行的趋势变化,或从趋势到震荡区间。
entries.definition_en: A trend change from up to down or down to up, or from a trend to a trading range.

entries.definition_zh: 二十根或更多连续未触及均线的K线。一旦市场最终触及均线,通常创造测试趋势极端的形态。
entries.definition_en: Twenty or more consecutive bars that have not touched the moving average. Once the market finally touches the moving average, it usually creates a setup for a test of the trend’s extreme.

entries.definition_zh: 市场接近但未到达先前有意义的价格,如摆动点或趋势线。
entries.definition_en: The market approaches but does not reach a prior price of significance like a swing point or a trend line.

entries.definition_zh: 至多 40% 确定。
entries.definition_en: At most 40 percent certain.

entries.definition_zh: 具有不利交易者公式的形态。
entries.definition_en: A setup with an unfavorable trader’s equation.

entries.definition_zh: 至少 60% 确定。
entries.definition_en: At least 60 percent certain.

entries.definition_zh: 买盘真空发生在强空头相信价格很快会更高、因此等待市场到达上方某个磁铁再做空时。结果是有真空以一根或多根多头趋势K线形式把市场迅速吸到磁铁。一旦到达,强空头激进卖出并把市场转下。卖盘真空发生在强多头相信市场很快会更低、因此等待它跌到下方某个磁铁再买入时。结果是有真空以一根或多根空头趋势K线形式把市场迅速吸到磁铁。一旦到达,强多头激进买入并把市场转回向上。
entries.definition_en: A buy vacuum occurs when the strong bears believe that the price will soon be higher so they wait to short until it reaches some magnet above the market. The result is that there is a vacuum that sucks the market quickly up to the magnet in the form of one or more bull trend bars. Once there, the strong bears sell aggressively and turn the market down. A sell vacuum occurs when the strong bulls believe that the market will soon be lower so they wait to buy until it falls to some magnet below the market. The result is that there is a vacuum that sucks the market down quickly to the magnet in the form of one or more bear trend bars. Once there, strong bulls buy aggressively and turn the market back up.

entries.definition_zh: 传统上,三推运动,每次推进进一步延伸,趋势线与趋势通道线至少最低限度收敛,创造上升或下降三角形与楔形形状。对交易者,楔形形状增加成功交易的机会,但任何三推形态都像楔形交易并可被视为楔形。楔形可以是反转形态或趋势中的回撤(多头或空头旗形)。
entries.definition_en: Traditionally, a three-push move with each push extending further and the trend line and trend channel line at least minimally convergent, creating a rising or descending triangle with a wedge shape. For a trader, the wedge shape increases the chances of a successful trade, but any three-push pattern trades like a wedge and can be considered one. A wedge can be a reversal pattern or a pullback in a trend (a bull or bear flag).
entries.note: wedge bull flag→楔形多头旗形

entries.definition_zh: 趋势中楔形或三推回撤,如多头趋势中的 High 3(一种多头旗形)或空头趋势中的 Low 3(一种空头旗形)。由于它是顺势形态,在第一次信号入场。
entries.definition_en: A wedge-shaped or three-push pullback in a trend, such as a high 3 in a bull trend (a type of bull flag) or a low 3 in a bear trend (a type of bear flag). Since it is a with-trend setup, enter on the first signal.

entries.definition_zh: 把多头趋势反转成空头趋势或把空头趋势反转成多头趋势的楔形。由于它是逆势的,除非非常强,最好等第二次信号。例如,若有空头趋势然后下降楔形,等待该潜在楔形底部上方突破,然后尝试买入到更高低点的回撤。
entries.definition_en: A wedge that is reversing a bull trend into a bear trend or a bear trend into a bull trend. Since it is countertrend, unless it is very strong, it is better xxvii to take a second signal. For example, if there is a bear trend and then a descending wedge, wait for a breakout above this potential wedge bottom and then try to buy a pullback to a higher low.

entries.definition_zh: 指与主导趋势方向相同的交易或形态。一般而言,最近 5 分钟图信号的方向应被假设为趋势方向。此外,若过去 10 或 20 根中多数在均线上方,趋势形态与交易可能在买入一侧。
entries.definition_en: Refers to a trade or a setup that is in the direction of the prevailing trend. In general, the direction of the most recent 5 minute chart signal should be assumed to be the trend’s direction. Also, if most of the past 10 or 20 bars are above the moving average, trend setups and trades are likely on the buy side. Trading Price Action TRENDS

entries.definition_zh: 价格图表上的一根价格柱;本书叙述中通常称为K线。
entries.definition_en: A single unit of plotted price data; in this book it is usually called a bar.
entries.note: 图表中的一根 bar;叙述中统一用「K线」;「bar by bar」译为「逐根K线」

definition_source.review_note: Generated from the glossary term and its translation notes; not a quotation from chapter 03.

entries.definition_zh: K线实体,即开盘价与收盘价之间的部分。
entries.definition_en: The body of a bar, spanning the area between its open and close.

definition_source.review_note: Generated from the glossary term and its translation notes; not a quotation from chapter 03.

entries.definition_zh: K线实体以外、表示价格曾到达但未收在该处的线段,也称影线。
entries.definition_en: The part of a bar extending beyond its body, showing prices reached but not held at the close; also called a wick or shadow.

definition_source.review_note: Generated from the glossary term and its translation notes; not a quotation from chapter 03.

entries.definition_zh: 看好价格上涨的一方;在本书术语中通常译作多头。
entries.definition_en: A participant or market condition oriented toward higher prices; rendered as bull or bullish in this book.

definition_source.review_note: Generated from the glossary term and its translation notes; not a quotation from chapter 03.

entries.definition_zh: 看好价格下跌的一方;在本书术语中通常译作空头。
entries.definition_en: A participant or market condition oriented toward lower prices; rendered as bear or bearish in this book.

definition_source.review_note: Generated from the glossary term and its translation notes; not a quotation from chapter 03.

entries.definition_zh: 价格总体向上推进、买方占主导的趋势。
entries.definition_en: A trend in which price generally advances and buyers are in control.
